audit_result.proof_trace: `util_rate = debt / (debt + cash - cash_reserve)` exceeds 1 whenever `cash_reserve > cash`. `accrue_interest` (L125-149) increases `cash_reserve` by `reserve_factor * interest` without any post-condition check on `cash >= cash_reserve`, while `cash` stays unchanged; the only guard (`withdraw_underlying` L313) fires only during withdrawals. At maximum utilization (e.g., cash=1 after near-total borrow), a few dozen seconds of interest accrual is sufficient for `cash_reserve` to surpass `cash`, causing the denominator `debt + cash - cash_reserve < debt` and `util_rate > 1`.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Deposit a large amount (e.g., 1B tokens), borrow the maximum allowed (~1B-1 tokens, leaving cash=1), then trigger any operation that calls `accrue_interest` (borrow/repay/liquidate on the same asset) after ~63 seconds at 5% APY with 1% reserve factor; `cash_reserve` grows past `cash=1`, `util_rate()` returns >1, and `calc_interest` in interest.move computes a weight >1 in its third branch (L86-95), yielding an interest rate above `max_borrow_rate` — violating the rate cap guarantee for all borrowers.

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-021.text: Utilization rate must be in [0, 1]; total_borrows / (total_supply + total_borrows) never exceeds 1.
